web-guide-idea-23.audience: People who enjoy poetry and storytelling in your language.
web-guide-idea-23.offer: Create an evening around a theme such as home, friendship or migration. Original writing and expressive delivery give listeners a reason to attend live.
web-guide-idea-23.steps.0: Select and rehearse a few connected pieces.
web-guide-idea-23.steps.1: Introduce each briefly and perform at an unhurried pace.
web-guide-idea-23.steps.2: Invite reflections and explain the next writing theme.
web-guide-idea-23.equipment: A phone, stand, quiet corner and clear audio. Notes are fine; keep eye contact where possible.
web-guide-idea-23.returnReason: Develop themed evenings or an unfolding story. Let returning listeners see your voice grow.
web-guide-idea-23.promotion: Post a short original excerpt that captures the mood without giving away the whole performance.

web-guide-idea-23.metadataDescription: Host an evening of original poetry, spoken word and storytelling in your favourite language. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
